entries.title: Infinitary answers right away after it starts, however many tasks finished on your other computers
entries.body: In the seconds after Infinitary started, it could stop answering clicks and typing for more than a second at a time while it checked the folders of tasks that finished on your other computers. That check is now quick, so the app answers as soon as it opens.
entries.noPicture: This removes a pause in how fast the app answers, which a still picture cannot show.
